name: prosemirror-devtools-monorepo
description: Development workspace for ProseMirror DevTools and its TanStack Devtools demo.
author: Riccardo Perra

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter prosemirror-devtools run build && pnpm --parallel --filter prosemirror-devtools --filter @prosemirror-devtools/tanstack-demo run dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter prosemirror-devtools run build && pnpm --recursive --if-present run typecheck
